name: Jason M. Pittman
biography: is currently a doctoral student with research interests in new methods of authentication, artificial life modeling for security, and games-based learning. Jason is an adjunct professor of Information Assurance, teaching young padawans the ways of the Sit...err, Jedi. As well, Jason has ten years of professional experience in security, working on a variety of projects ranging from the technical, compliance & governance, and some fun stuff here too.
